Uncaught TypeError: 'set' on proxy: trap returned falsish for property Name

🔴 The Problem: Am not doing anything fancy, just trying to update a field on Contact in JS of LWC but getting this exception. Uncaught TypeError: 'set' on proxy: trap returned falsish for property 'Name' throws at mydomain/auraFW/javascript/mhontaYdOya4Y_lBu7v9yg/aura_prod.js:2:27687 HTML Code: JS: Apex: On top of my head, am not doing anything wrong, anyone has idea what's wrong with my code? ✅ The Fix: Cached items are set as read-only (because otherwise you could corrupt the cache). If you want a modifiable object, you need to clone it.
